title: List browser pages
description: List bounded, automatable browser pages using opaque page context IDs.

activeOnly.description: When true, return only the active browser page.

limit.description: Maximum pages to return; defaults to 25.

inputSchema.description: Filters for the bounded browser page catalog.

pages.description: Automatable pages represented by opaque page context IDs.

pageContextId.description: Opaque page identifier accepted by page observation and action capabilities.

active.description: Whether this is the active browser page.

kind.description: agent: a page opened for an agent (dsagent.page.open, a guided wizard, a named browser session); person: one of the person's own tabs.

mine.description: True for a page opened for you; you may act on it, emulate it and close it. Another agent's page refuses your actions (POLICY_DENIED PAGE_OWNED_BY_OTHER_AGENT) while that agent works; an unattended agent page becomes yours when you act on it.

agentName.description: The other agent working on this page, when it is theirs and still connected.

held.description: Who holds the page now: a guided wizard, a workflow run, or another agent's lease on the person's page (TARGET_BUSY until it lapses).

session.description: The browser session the page is in: default (the person's own), named (sessionGroup new/previous; reopen with previous and sessionName), account (a managed application account's own session; open pages in it with dsagent.page.open accountId) or other (a session agents cannot open pages in, such as a workflow run's isolated one).

sessionName.description: With named: the session's name, for sessionGroup previous.

accountId.description: With account: the opaque application account id, for dsagent.page.open accountId.

accountName.description: With account: the account's label in the person's account catalog.

heldBy.description: The agent holding the lease, with held another-agent.

total.description: Total matching page count before the requested limit.

outputSchema.description: Bounded catalog of automatable browser pages.
